requirements.quote: All proposals must be submitted at the following email address: tender@csir.co.za
requirements.text: Proposals must be submitted to the specified email address.
Tender documents will be issued on 01 September 2022.

requirements.quote: Compulsory briefing session / site inspection etc: 05 September 2022
requirements.text: Compulsory briefing session or site inspection is on 05 September 2022.

requirements.text: Queries must be submitted by 09 September 2022.
Proposals must be submitted by 16 September 2022.

requirements.quote: Proposals must consist of two parts, each of which is placed in a separate sealed package clearly marked: PART 1: Technical Proposal: RFP No-1028-16-09-2022 PART 2: Pricing Proposal, B-BBEE and other Mandatory Documentation: RFP No -1028-16-09-2022
requirements.text: Proposals must be submitted in two separately sealed and clearly marked packages.

requirements.quote: Proposals submitted by companies must be signed by a person or persons duly authorised.
requirements.text: Proposals must be signed by an authorized representative.

requirements.quote: The CSIR will award the contract to qualified tenderer(s)’ whose proposal is determined to be the most advantageous to the CSIR, taking into consideration the technical (functional) solution, price and B-BBEE.
requirements.text: The contract will be awarded to the most advantageous proposal considering technical solution, price, and B-BBEE.

requirements.quote: Proposals shall be submitted at the address mentioned above no later than the closing date of Friday, 16 September 2022 during CSIR’s business hours. The CSIR business hours are between 08h00 and 16h30.
requirements.text: Proposals must be submitted by 16 September 2022 during CSIR business hours (08h00 to 16h30).

requirements.quote: Where a proposal is not received by the CSIR by the due date and stipulated place, it will be regarded as a late tender. Late tenders will not be considered.
requirements.text: Late proposals will not be considered.
